title: PhilHealth eyes 60M YAKAP beneficiaries by end-2027
summary: PhilHealth is targeting to expand the number of beneficiaries under its Yaman ng Kalusugan Program (YAKAP) to 60 million by the end of 2027, as it pushes for greater access to preventive healthcare.
